title: Kar gaye sajjad qaza
body:
Kar gaye sajjad qaza haaye haaye
Zehr sitamgar ne diya haaye haaye
Zulm se li jaan sitamgaaro'n ne
charqe kohan phat na pada haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho gaye be waarise sab ahlebait
kar gaya sardaar qaza haaye haaye
chain na paaya kabhi baade hussain
sehte rahe zulmo jafa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aati hai har ek makaa'n se sada
Haaye ghareebul ghoraba haaye haaye
Mehdi hua mehshar taaza bapa
ro rahe hai aale abaa haaye haaye
